description: This file defines classes and functions for handling trace data, including Trace and TraceEntry classes, with methods for slicing, searching, and managing trace entries, timestamps, and frames in a trace analysis tool.

classes.name: TraceEntry
classes.description: Represents a single trace entry with methods to access its properties such as timestamp, value, and frame range.

classes.name: Trace
classes.description: Represents a trace object with methods for accessing, slicing, and searching trace entries, managing frame and timestamp info.

methods.name: TraceEntry.getFullTrace
methods.description: Returns the full trace object associated with this entry.

methods.name: TraceEntry.getIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of this trace entry.

methods.name: TraceEntry.getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp associated with this trace entry.

methods.name: TraceEntry.getFramesRange
methods.description: Returns the frame range for this trace entry if available.

methods.name: TraceEntry.getValue
methods.description: Returns the value of the trace entry using the parser.

methods.name: Trace.getDescriptors
methods.description: Returns descriptors of the trace.

methods.name: Trace.getTimestampType
methods.description: Returns the timestamp type of the trace.

methods.name: Trace.setFrameInfo
methods.description: Sets frame mapping and range information for the trace.

methods.name: Trace.hasFrameInfo
methods.description: Checks if frame info is available for the trace.

methods.name: Trace.getEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a trace entry at a given relative index.

methods.name: Trace.getFrame
methods.description: Returns a sub-trace corresponding to a specific frame index.

methods.name: Trace.findClosestEntry
methods.description: Finds the closest trace entry to a given timestamp.

methods.name: Trace.findFirstGreaterOrEqualEntry
methods.description: Finds the first trace entry with timestamp >= given time.

methods.name: Trace.findFirstGreaterEntry
methods.description: Finds the first trace entry with timestamp > given time.

methods.name: Trace.findLastLowerOrEqualEntry
methods.description: Finds the last trace entry with timestamp <= given time.

methods.name: Trace.findLastLowerEntry
methods.description: Finds the last trace entry with timestamp < given time.

methods.name: Trace.sliceEntries
methods.description: Returns a sliced trace based on start and end relative indices.

methods.name: Trace.sliceTime
methods.description: Returns a sliced trace based on start and end timestamps.

methods.name: Trace.sliceFrames
methods.description: Returns a sliced trace based on frame range.

methods.name: Trace.forEachEntry
methods.description: Iterates over each trace entry.

methods.name: Trace.forEachTimestamp
methods.description: Iterates over each timestamp.

methods.name: Trace.forEachFrame
methods.description: Iterates over each frame.

methods.name: Trace.getFramesRange
methods.description: Returns the range of frames if available.

methods.name: Trace.getFullTraceTimestamps
methods.description: Retrieves all timestamps for the full trace.

methods.name: Trace.convertToAbsoluteEntryIndex
methods.description: Converts a relative index to an absolute index.

methods.name: Trace.createSlice
methods.description: Creates a new trace slice based on specified entries and frames.

methods.name: Trace.clampEntriesRangeToSliceBounds
methods.description: Clamps entries range to slice bounds.

methods.name: Trace.clampFramesRangeToSliceBounds
methods.description: Clamps frames range to slice bounds.

methods.name: Trace.clampEntryToSliceBounds
methods.description: Clamps a single entry index to slice bounds.

methods.name: Trace.clampFrameToSliceBounds
methods.description: Clamps a single frame index to slice bounds.

methods.name: Trace.checkTraceCanBeAccessedInFrameDomain
methods.description: Checks if trace can be accessed in frame domain.

methods.name: Trace.checkTimestampIsCompatible
methods.description: Checks if a timestamp is compatible with the trace.
